axisNote: Both bounds have leading exponent s=2−t. Green and red are separated by a few screen pixels only for visibility; that offset does not encode a numerical gap. Logarithmic factors and exact finite-n ranges are retained below. Open endpoints mean fixed t<1 (algorithm) and fixed t<1/2 (lower bound), not inclusion of β=n or β=√n.
coverageNote: One preprint contains a new deterministic lower bound and a folklore upper bound. Maximum cardinality is distinct from inclusion-maximality. This is not a randomized streaming frontier.
